decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe builds directly on the firm's tube and plastic materials expertise, and the external recognition shows it can interpret and exploit market feedback, so it fits the firm's knowledge base well.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a core item in the geothermal plastic-pipe range and draws on established extrusion competence, so the firm can readily assimilate learning and improve it.

The surface technology line complements the probes as a system solution that uses the firm's integrated production and service know-how, although its several models create some pressure to prune variants.
The fire-protection steel profile system extends the firm's long-standing steel profile expertise into a regulated, certification-heavy niche where accumulated knowledge is a durable advantage.
The slim steel profile system relies on the same rolling and profiling technology as the core building systems business, so it is closely related to existing knowledge and easy to refine.

The decorative surface system is somewhat further from the firm's core metallurgical competence and more exposed to fashion, but it still builds on the profile platform and supports customized solutions.
